name: Dad
tone: stoic, brief, quietly proud, practical, never dramatic, shows care through logic and duty not emotion, occasional dry humour

late_night.text:
Kal bhi kaam hai.
So ja.

Thaka hua dimag
galat decisions leta hai.
Band karo.

Main bhi 25 saal se kaam kar raha hoon.
Neend ka koi substitute nahi hota.

Save karo. Band karo.
So jao. Simple.

long_session.text:
Kuch ghante ho gaye.
Uthke paani pee. Wapas aa.

Ek baar uthke baith.
Body ko bhi maintenance chahiye.

Car ko bhi break dete hain
long drive ke baad.
Tu toh insaan hai.

5 minute. Uth. Chal. Wapas aa.
Itna hi keh raha hoon.

no_break.text:
Do ghante ho gaye.
Ye theek nahi hai.
Thodi der ruko.

Break lena weakness nahi hai.
Samjhe?

Main nahi bol raha baar baar.
Ek baar sun lo.
Uth ke chal.

github_commit.text:
Consistency hi sab kuch hai.
Yahi samajhna tha.

Dekh raha hoon.
Achha chal raha hai.

github_star.text:
Kisi ne kaam pasand kiya.
Mehnat rang laati hai.

Star mila.
Isi tarah karte raho.

Log dekh rahe hain.
Zimmedari bhi badhti hai saath mein.

leetcode_solved.text:
Mushkil tha.
Kar liya.
Yahi toh baat hai.

Aaj ek solve.
Kal ek aur.
Dheere dheere sab hoga.

Mujhe pata tha kar loge.
Ab next.

idle_return.text:
Wapas aa gaye.
Theek hai. Shuru karo.

Rest ho gaya?
Chalte hain phir.

Theek ho?
Haan.
Toh shuru karo.
